_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
11:59AM - Frank's Fall Line is now open to the public!

Lift Updates: Current lifts open include: Gondola, Snow Bowl Express, Ursa Express, Sunrise Express, American Express, Tamarack, Cub Carpet, Theodore Carpet, Tyro Tube, and Oso Carpet.

Shuttle Services Update: The only shuttles that will operate today are: Rising Bear, Hearthstone, Founders, Stratton Springs, Bear Creek, Lot 1, Lot 2, Green Apron and Sun Bowl.

Activities Update: Tubing, Snowmobile Tours, and Snow-Go Tours are closed for the day. We will assess Mini-Z operational safety, as well as Ice skating conditions throughout the day. Climb is open 10am-6pm.

12/29 5:45AM - Last night we had mixed precipitation consisting of everything from snow, ice, rain, and sleet. These conditions are expected to continue into this morning and turn into rain this afternoon as temperatures rise. Due to the weather there will be lift and terrain delays. The tentative plan is to have 55 trails, all of which will be receiving a morning groom prior to opening. We plan on 12 lifts scheduled to spin at 8:30AM with several starting on wind and weather delays. There will be no early access today. 

Our Mountain Operations Team is dedicated to providing the best experience and conditions possible, with or without Mother Nature on our side. All hands are on deck as the entire team has been working around the clock and will continue to do so. Thankfully, there’s some light at the end of the tunnel with snow forecasted for tonight and temperatures dropping to allow a solid window for snowmaking to resume. Be sure to check back to the report often for the most up to date information.

On a lighter note, today is Stratton’s 64th birthday! Swing by the courtyard to celebrate with free cupcakes at 3:30pm while supplies last. Additionally, we will be having some surprise giveaways throughout the day. Hope to see you there!

Safety Tip: Never duck a rope, they are there for a reason. 

Hungry? Luckily for you, Holiday week is in full swing with extended dining hours, live music, and special events keeping the Village looking lively. Check out our Holiday Week Dining, Après & Live Music Guide to see what's open, happening, and where the music is at.

The Holidays have arrived at Stratton! The Village is decorated with lights and the schedule is decked with events. Après heats up with live music at Grizzly's, cozy nights at Paint & Sip, and festive fun rolling all week long into a stacked lineup of New Year’s celebrations. Ring it in your way with family dinners, dancing it out at the Silent Disco, hiking up for a one of a kind fireworks view, or watching the fireworks light up the mountain from the base area. There’s something for everyone this Holiday week and we couldn’t be more excited to celebrate with you! Click here to check out the upcoming Events Calendar.

The Coca-Cola Tube Park is now open for the season! Reservations are recommended to save your spot while availability lasts. Tubing is available in 50 minute sessions starting at the top of each hour. Book now to secure your tickets! Please read the details and policies prior to purchasing your tickets. 

Want to go on an adventure of a lifetime? Well, you're in luck, our Guided Snowmobile Tours are back! Explore Stratton after hours with friends and family on a tour to the summit. Be sure to book your spot now to guarantee it.

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability.
